description: REMix provides modular energy-system optimisation for technology design, sector interactions and multi-year pathways. It supports alternative objective indicators, including environmental and resilience measures, and large spatial and technology representations. The provider is German Aerospace Center (DLR). Coverage: The framework is generic to configured energy systems. Resolution and years are chosen for individual models, not supplied as one fixed dataset. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The provider documentation includes BSD 3-Clause terms. Data and external optimisation software retain their own conditions. Limitations: The reviewed documentation is a development version. Continuing maintenance and several applications are described, but this review did not execute the framework. For simulation it supports techno-economic energy-system design and pathway comparison. Related resources: Existing data-remix-eur-european-energy-system-data and data-powger-germany-remix-power-system are inputs for applications, not records for the REMix framework.
